ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High bimodal contrast; central regions exhibit high-intensity white-to-cream pixels, while margins and focal spots exhibit low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous regions are located in the center of both the left and right lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous perimeter boundary and converge at the fluke base. Irregular dark mottling is concentrated primarily along the trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; estimated pixel angle between lobe tangents is approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations observed along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases toward the distal tips, presenting a jagged, non-linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curvature sweeping upward and outward from the median notch to the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped dark pixel clusters (rosettes) are visible, particularly on the right lobe where several 10-20 pixel diameter dark rings are set against the high-intensity white background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both ventral lobes, characterized by dark-bordered rings and solid dark circular focal points.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct 'bridge' of high-intensity pixels extends nearly to the median notch, separated only by a narrow low-intensity vertical midline.
